name: Forensics Challenge
content:
Analyze this forensic file : {file_path}
Assumed type : {file_type:unknown}

**Identification :**
```bash
file {file_path}
xxd {file_path} | head
binwalk {file_path}
exiftool {file_path}
```

**By file type :**

**Image :**
```bash
steghide extract -sf image.jpg
zsteg image.png
stegsolve  # GUI
foremost -i image.jpg
```

**PDF :**
```bash
pdftotext file.pdf
pdf-parser.py file.pdf
peepdf file.pdf
```

**Archive :**
```bash
7z x file.zip
binwalk -e file.bin
foremost -i file.raw
```

**Memory dump :**
```bash
vol.py -f dump.raw imageinfo
vol.py -f dump.raw --profile=X pslist
vol.py -f dump.raw --profile=X filescan
```

**Disk image :**
```bash
mmls image.dd
fls -r image.dd
autopsy  # GUI
```

**Advanced steganography :**
- LSB encoding
- Whitespace
- Audio spectrogram
